1.text: Isazi zipfuye zituma amadahano yoshejwe n'abosa anuka nabi, ni ko ubupfapfa buke bwonona ubwenge n'icyubahiro.

2.text: Umutima w'umunyabwenge uri iburyo bwe, ariko umutima w'umupfapfa uri ibumoso bwe.

3.text: Ariko kandi iyo umupfapfa ari mu nzira ubwenge buramucika, umuntu abonye wese akamwita umupfu.

4.text: Umutegetsi nakurakarira ntukamuhunge, kuko gutuza guhosha ibicumuro bikomeye.

5.text: Hariho ikibi nabonye munsi y'ijuru, ni cyo gicumuro gikorwa n'umutegetsi:

6.text: abapfapfa bashyirwa imbere, kandi imfura zigasubizwa inyuma.

7.text: Nabonye abaretwa bagendera ku mafarashi, na byo ibikomangoma bigendesha amaguru nk'abaretwa.

8.text: Ucukura urwobo azarugwamo, kandi umena urugo inzoka izamurya.

9.text: Ucukura amabuye azakomeretswa na yo, n'uwasa inkwi zimushyira mu kaga.

10.text: Intorezo iyo igimbye nyirayo ntayityaze, aba akwiriye kuyongera amaboko, ariko ubwenge bugira akamaro ko kuyobora.

11.text: Umugombozi iyo ariwe n'inzoka atigomboye aba yari amaze iki?

12.text: Amagambo ava mu kanwa k'umunyabwenge amutera igikundiro, ariko iminwa y'umupfapfa izamuroha mu rumira.

13.text: Itangira ry'amagambo ava mu kanwa ke ni ubupfapfa, kandi iherezo ry'amagambo ye ni ubusazi butera amahane.

14.text: Umupfapfa ahomboka mu magambo menshi. Umuntu ntazi ibizaba, kandi ibizaba mu nyuma ze ni nde wabasha kubimubwira?

15.text: Imirimo y'abapfapfa ibananiza bose, kuko umupfapfa atazi uko akwiriye kujya ku murwa.

16.text: Wa gihugu we, iyo ufite umwami ari umwana muto, kandi ibikomangoma byawe bikaba ibiryakare, uba ubonye ishyano.

17.text: Wa gihugu we, ube uhiriwe iyo ufite umwana w'imfura ho umwami, kandi ibikomangoma byawe bikarya mu gihe gikwiriye, kugira ngo bigire amagara bitarimo isindwe.

18.text: Ubute bugoramisha igisenge, kandi amaboko adeha atuma inzu iva.

19.text: Ibirori bigirirwa gusetsa, kandi vino inezeza ubugingo, kandi ifeza ni yo isubiza ibintu byose.

20.text: Ntugatuke umwami ndetse ntukabitekereze, ntugatuke abakire uri mu nzu uryamamo, kuko inyoni yo mu kirere yagurukana ijwi ryawe, kandi igifite amababa cyabyamamaza.
